vessels/vessel-clock-tower.png:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: closed assembled vessel master for the Time Capsule app.
Input image: design/art/style-sheet.png is the approved style reference, not an edit target. Match its clean ink and soft fill style exactly.
Subject: An original small standing keepsake clock, loosely inspired by the red-brick and pale-granite material contrast of the Tsim Sha Tsui clock tower. It is a portable souvenir object, not a replica of the real tower. A simple square pale stone clock-face panel sits on the front of a slim red-brick tower body. The face has exactly two simple brass hands attached to one central hub, with no numerals, tick marks, writing, or symbols. The entire square clock-face panel is a visible side-hinged door, with a slim hinge at the viewer's left and a tiny brass latch at the viewer's right. Clearly draw the seam around the complete panel so it can be separated later. The tower stands on its own broad pale-stone base; show a small roof/cap at top. The front door is fully closed; no interior visible. Keep silhouette simple enough for 40 px and 120 px.
Composition: one square transparent canvas; object centered horizontally; width no more than 74% of canvas; lowest opaque pixel about 89% height; at least 10% free above; no ground shadow beyond object; front three-quarter view so the front panel and right side are visible.
Constraints: original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text. No exact landmark silhouette or copied architectural ornament. Genuine alpha transparency at all four corners. Use only approved palette; red brick should use wax red and plum with a little pale stone.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
